inputs.caption:
Global Metadata: Warm acoustic pop at 96 BPM in C major. Intimate and hopeful, starting gently and building into a wide final chorus. Clean modern production with natural dynamics.

Vocal Details: Soft female lead vocal with a clear, breathy timbre and close phrasing. Light stacked harmonies enter in the chorus.

Arrangement: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar and soft piano open the song. Brushed drums and upright bass enter in the verse, then strings and wider backing vocals lift the chorus. End with a short piano resolution.
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Morning light is falling through the trees
Every quiet street begins to breathe
We can take the long way home today
Following the colors as they change

[Chorus]
Carry this melody into the sky
Hold to the moment as the clouds roll by
Every new day starts with a song
Sing it together and carry it on

[Outro]
Carry it on
